Production DaoOriginValidator only checks the final signature option and classifies replay, then DaoManager parses route options afterward. TransitInformation.from_option() additionally accepts length \u003e=20 with the parent flag and silently ignores trailing authenticated bytes (and accepts non-profile short/no-parent forms), so a signed noncanonical DAO can install a route.
